page_title: DOR 1-1 LEV | Dortmund v Bayer Leverkusen 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.

90+7' 1 - 1 Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner kick and scores with a great header aimed low into the middle of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is 1:1.
90+7' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90+7' Now Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
90+7' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Gregor Kobel to dive and make a save.
90+6' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
90+5' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
90+3' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Patrik Schick wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
90+1' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+1' Referee Daniel Siebert waves Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) back on as his red card is expunged after a VAR review!

90+1' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), but referee Daniel Siebert must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) sees a very strict red card that makes him really angry. His indignation can't change the decision of the referee, though.
88' The referee is firm and issues Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) a deserved yellow card.
88' This is a yellow card! Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
85' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
83' Substitution. Jonas Hofmann leaves the pitch and is replaced by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen).
83' Edin Terzic prepares a substitution. Jamie Bynoe-Gittens is replaced by Julien Duranville (Dortmund).
83' Substitution. Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) on for Julian Brandt.
83' Substitution. Piero Hincapie did his best and is replaced by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen).
81' 1 - 0 What a hit! Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the left post. 1:0.
79' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
78' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
78' Marco Reus (Dortmund) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
75' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
73' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a through ball but overhits it.
70' It is time for a substitution. Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is on for Nathan Tella.
69' Edin Terzic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marco Reus (Dortmund) replacing Jadon Sancho.
69' Substitution. Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Emre Can walks off.
68' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
68' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the corner into the box, but Gregor Kobel intercepts it and averts the threat.
67' 51:49 – the ratio of ball possession.
66' Emre Can (Dortmund) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniel Siebert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
64' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
61' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a precise pass into the box, but Nathan Tella loses the one-on-one with the defender.
61' The linesman raises his flag. Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is adjudged offside.
58' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
57' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

57' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the underside of the bar, but Gregor Kobel denies him with a great save.
56' Dangerous play by Emre Can (Dortmund). Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
54' A cross from the side flies outside the box to Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen). He attempts to score, but chooses power over accuracy which causes his projectile to go well over the bar.
52' The game is interrupted now, Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
51' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) and Emre Can attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
49' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) sends a chip pass into the box, but Lukas Hradecky is quickest to intercept the ball.
48' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukas Hradecky intercepts the ball.
47' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jonas Hofmann.
46' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) prepares to take a corner kick.
46' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
46' Edin Terzic makes a half-time substitution. Marius Wolf comes on in place of Ian Maatsen (Dortmund).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniel Siebert had an easy-decision to make.
45+2' Emre Can (Dortmund) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Alejandro Grimaldo picks out Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the right post.

42' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Lukas Hradecky shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
41' The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.
40' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
39' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
38' This will be a very dangerous free kick from just outside the box and it's a very promising distance, indeed. Let's see what Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will come up with.
37' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) for his blatant foul.

36' That's unlucky! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
34' A spell of possession for Bayer Leverkusen in an attempt to control the game.
32' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.

31' There's a break in play and referee Daniel Siebert must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bayer Leverkusen using VAR. This could be interesting!
30' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
29' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
28' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) has tested the patience of referee Daniel Siebert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
26' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) and Alejandro Grimaldo attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
24' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
24' Daniel Siebert blows for a foul after Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
23' The ball is cleared after Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
21' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
21' Gregor Kobel leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen).
20' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
19' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal.
16' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
15' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
14' That's a well-taken pass by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
11' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) sends a long ball in, but Lukas Hradecky comfortably gathers the ball.
9' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for an infringement.
8' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) latches onto a long cross into the centre of the box by Nathan Tella but can't keep his header down, sending it high over the bar.
7' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
5' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
5' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a one-two with Alejandro Grimaldo, but the move breaks down.
3' Some great controlled play and passing from Bayer Leverkusen. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Bayer Leverkusen will take the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
